ai_policy.summary: Journal permits disclosed AI-assisted text, code, data and analysis with human verification and full author responsibility. Manuscripts predominantly AI-generated without substantial human intellectual contribution are not accepted.

disclosure.instructions: Disclose tool, provider, model/version where available, access dates, purpose, stage and extent, and human verification. Initial full statement goes on title page; include anonymized statement if needed for review; accepted manuscript has Declarations before references. If AI is a research instrument or study object, describe settings, prompts, dates and validation in methodology. Routine non-generative spelling, formatting and reference management are exempt.
disclosure.section: Required Declarations sections 1 and 7; Publication Ethics section 16

restrictions: Predominantly AI-generated manuscripts without substantial human intellectual contribution are not accepted.
Verify outputs against reliable original sources; do not cite generated output as a source.
Do not fabricate evidence or upload protected information without lawful basis and safeguards.
AI cannot be an author or contributor.

policy_sources.note: Discloses generated text, code, data and analysis; human responsibility and contribution required.
Specifies contents and placement of AI-use disclosure.
